steps.name: Normal independent app launch
steps.evidence: Actual CUA launch; private login state; native account and secure password fields.

steps.name: Sidebar collapse and restore
steps.evidence: Actual native controls and updated accessibility tree.

steps.name: On-demand WebKit page
steps.evidence: Actual Remote website loaded; Close removed HTML content and restored native login. This is an independent webpage, not verified shared-session plugin embedding.

steps.name: Brand and unauthenticated navigation
steps.evidence: Final 2560x1640 capture has original whale, name and white HARNESS label; no raw protocol-error banner. Full typography and animation visual parity remain open.

steps.name: Authorized Host and native history presentation
steps.evidence: User completed native login. CUA verified saved authorization survived app restart, online MacMini connection, MAM-Go workspace filtering and a completed session rendered with native Markdown/table. No prompt, cancellation or approval action was performed. The independent readOnly probe has separate evidence in runtime-results/live-readonly.json.

limitations: Reference screenshot contains private session data and remains local.
M1 performance and battery consumption not tested.
Published release signing and notarization not performed.
Local fixture and functional frame counters are not live Remote performance evidence.
No currently running Host session existed for live streaming/reconnect observations.
Real prompt/cancel/approval/question operations remain fixture-verified only.
Original context/tool grouping and complete visual parity are not yet reproduced.
Real-history screenshot includes private data and must remain local.

localMemoryObservation.method: vmmap -summary, physical footprint, one observation after real completed history displayed
localMemoryObservation.limits: Not a same-workload comparison, not M1, not a sustained or peak application measurement. No compatibility WebView open.
